survey: A spiral topiary shrub in a round stone-edged planter on a paved garden path. The shrub is a single leafy spiral that winds upward in four tiers, getting narrower toward a pointed leaf tuft at the top. Each tier rests on the one below and follows the spiral, so there are no floating pieces. The bottom tier sits on brown soil inside the planter and spreads almost to the rim without crossing it. The planter is a ring of curved stone curb blocks. It is round in perspective, the blocks are evenly sized and joined, and it sits flat on the paving. It faces the camera at a slight three-quarter angle from above. The trimmed hedge and lawn behind it are background only.
